follow-up time: not specified, but data was collected during the delivery hospitalization
study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 418 mothers who delivered full-term, singleton infants
finding: Mothers who deliver by Caesarean have higher odds of reporting low milk supply and infant behaviour/health difficulties than women who deliver vaginally.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with low milk supply and infant behaviour/health difficulties.
